title: Book Distribution Drives
summary: Conducting book distribution drives for government school students, ensuring access to essential learning materials.
description: APJ Abdul Kalam Seva Samithi regularly conducts notebook and textbook distribution drives in rural and government schools. Inspired by Dr. Kalam's belief that 'books are our best companions', we identify schools where students lack resources and supply them with quality books and learning kits to encourage consistent schooling.

title: Student Welfare & Educational Support
summary: Providing school bags, uniforms, stationery kits, and merit scholarships to support underprivileged children.
description: We are dedicated to removing financial barriers to basic education. By distributing school bags, uniforms, stationery kits, and financial aid to meritorious students from low-income families, the trust ensures that no child is forced to drop out of school due to a lack of resources.

title: Community Outreach & Hospital Services
summary: Assisting patients and families in government hospital shelters with regular food distribution and medical help.
description: The trust is actively involved in local community care. We regularly visit government hospitals to distribute nutritious food, fruits, and basic care packages to patients and their attendants, offering support and comfort during their hours of need.

title: Blood Donation Drives
summary: Organizing blood donation camps in partnership with the Red Cross and government blood banks.
description: To address emergency healthcare needs, we run blood donation camps in collaboration with local hospital blood banks and the Red Cross. Our volunteers and community members participate actively, ensuring local blood centers are stocked with life-saving resources.
metric: Organized in association with Red Cross

title: Swachh Bharat Cleanliness Drives
summary: Participating in public sanitation drives, community cleanup programs, and waste management awareness.
description: Cleanliness is vital for public health. Guided by the Swachh Bharat mission, our volunteers lead clean-up programs in public parks, school grounds, and local streets, helping to keep our surroundings clean and raise civic hygiene awareness.

title: Free Medical & Health Camps
summary: Conducting health screenings, eye checkups, and free medicine distribution camps for rural communities.
description: In cooperation with medical professionals and local clinics, the trust hosts free health checkup camps in remote villages. We provide free consultations, primary diagnostic checks, and essential medicines to individuals who have limited access to healthcare.
